model_helpers.build: Reconstruct actual native TT physical source bases only for selected exact transverse charged fiber, require27/162 ranks and cache basis/field agreement, load literal cached owning H components. Other48 occupied sea modes are NOT deleted/frozen; every charged162 TT state is still a global nine-block filled-sea state.
model_helpers.install/evolve: Actual adjoint and batched matrix-free owning-H propagation. Complete EM-off control keeps scalar quantum coupling, has its own factorized matter-Phi x EM eigensystem/reference and evolves under that actual physical control.
model_helpers.canonical_sources: All4 canonical mirror/frame spinor components at all3 kz, actual CAR creation/removal sectors, direct physical TT projection and full occupation matrices for raw source-weight/omission accounting. Selected transverse source plane, not positive-energy branch selection.
model_helpers.act: Sector-aware field or canonical source insertion on raw unnormalized intermediate vectors. Only actualN54/N55/N53 needed for one source pair; no invented holes/positrons or two active charges.
model_helpers.field_cut_weights: Exact rectangular coordinate maps from retained complete shell2 to complete shell3 for full-before-cut Q-product/source weights. Basis shell occupation is NOT photon number.

correlator_helpers.two_points: Owning full-time source12x12 addition/removal and real-profile field4x4 matrices, own field means, both signed time branches and finite-frequency time-ordered/retarded windows. No low-pole substitute in connected subtraction.
correlator_helpers.pair_catalog/pair_states/four_point: All24 chronological orders via physical ket and adjoint-bra pair strings; correct fermion T sign, owning intermediate H sectors, no intermediate normalization. Only UNUSED pair states omitted from cache; every requested tensor entry computed.
correlator_helpers.fourier_legs: Incoming Q_etaIn, outgoing Q_-etaOut, both signs and both polarizations. Complete raw tensor retains forbidden channels rather than filtering them to zero.
correlator_helpers.spectral_window: Own-H low-eigenwindow residues, complete degenerate groups except possibly final window edge. Raw source norms and unresolved high weight retained. This diagnostic never replaces full time Green functions or establishes an isolated photon/electron pole.
correlator_helpers.finite_cut_eom: Actual i[H,Q]-Pi/I and i[H,Pi]-J defects on neutral and canonical unnormalized source vectors; no suppression of finite-cut coordinate/Peierls projection defects.
correlator_helpers.vertices: Raw same-state canonical-source matrices Vdag J V and Vdag K_ab V, full12x12 mode/spinor structure, both source branches and Fourier q current selection. Interpretation only: never add a second seagull to full-H four-point.

Time spacings0,.15,.30; all24 permutations; kzOut0,1,2; spinor0..3=(mirror,primitiveFrameComponent); pol[x,y]; qSigns[-1,+1]. kzIn0. Complete data, not scalar/contact summary.

complex_NPZ_schema.<arm>_two_point_positive/negative: Complex[positiveTime,modeOut,modeIn], mode=kz*4+spinor. Raw source Gram at time0; negative branch is removal before fermion T sign/index reversal. ActualN53 hole momentum opposite canonical removed mode.

complex_NPZ_schema.<arm>_G_T_window/D_T_window/G_R_window/D: Finite signed-frequency windows with definitions in equations.json, not free resolvents or independent Dyson kernels.
complex_NPZ_schema.<arm>_tau*_forward/adjoint_bra_<sector>: Raw pair-action weight rows: forward aligns to result.raw_pair_catalog.right[sector], adjoint_bra to raw_pair_catalog.left[sector]. Columns[beforeNorm2,fullPhysicalActionNorm2,retainedNorm2,omittedDifference]. Weights are operator-string strengths, not conditional probabilities; numerical negatives not clipped.
complex_NPZ_schema.<arm>_tau*_middle_norm2_<sector>: Raw norm squared after owning middle propagation, aligned to right/forward pair catalog. No normalized/filter states.

Equal-time connected dressing and later dynamical variation separately named; T cumulant is not retarded causal scattering proof. Translation/current/field operators are distinct, no Pcm=J or COM/internal factorization imposed.

Field Q legs and finite bright modes are not auxiliary oscillator photon occupation/helicity. No on-shell Compton/cross section/freeCOM/bulk/Lorentz/Nature promotion.
